mapper.insert: insert into work_tasks ( tenant_id, house_id, task_type, subject_type, subject_id, cycle_id, rabbit_id, batch_id, cage_id, due_date, due_time, status, snooze_count, dedup_key, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{taskType}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{cycleId}, #{rabbitId}, #{batchId}, #{cageId}, #{dueDate}, #{dueTime}, #{status}, 0, #{dedupKey}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() ) on duplicate key update task_type = values(task_type), subject_type = values(subject_type), subject_id = values(subject_id), cycle_id = values(cycle_id), rabbit_id = values(rabbit_id), batch_id = values(batch_id), cage_id = values(cage_id), due_date = values(due_date), due_time = values(due_time), status = values(status), completed_event_id = null, remark = values(remark), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select * from work_tasks where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id} limit 1
select * from work_tasks where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id} limit 1 for update
